assay: bulk RNA-seq (Illumina HiSeq 4000, paired-end, HISAT2 mm10), mouse kidney
organism: Mus musculus, male C57BL/6J, 4 months old
sample_inclusion: 3 kidneys per group sequenced (S2.4.p1) out of n=10 mice/group in the animal study (S2.2.p1): GC, HU (vehicle PBS), HU-t (HU + 4-PBA 100 mg/kg/d i.p.)

grp: HU (hindlimb unloaded, 3 weeks tail suspension, vehicle)

primary_estimand: Effect of 3 weeks of hindlimb unloading (mechanical disuse / physical inactivity model; the physical-activity axis of this paper, the inverse of loading/exercise) on the kidney transcriptome: HU vs GC. 4-PBA contrasts are drug effects, secondary.
planned_contrasts: HU vs GC (S3.3.p1, Fig. 4a; paper: 6628 DEGs, 4592 up / 2036 down)
HU-t vs HU (S3.3.p1, Fig. 4b; paper: 3543 DEGs, 1096 up / 2447 down)
HU-t vs GC (S3.3.p1, Fig. 4c; paper: 1114 DEGs, 890 up / 224 down)
repeated_measure_unit: none; one kidney per mouse, independent animals
normalization: read counts -> FPKM for PCA/heatmaps (S2.7.p1); DESeq2 on quantification data (S2.8.p1)
paper_method: DESeq2 pairwise comparisons on read counts (S2.8.p1; S2.4.p1 mentions DESeq2/EdgeR)
paper_results: HU vs GC: ECM organization/ECM-receptor interaction, olfactory transduction, collagen degradation, muscle contraction up; mitochondrial protein complex, OXPHOS/TCA, SLC-mediated transport down (S3.3.p2, S3.4.p1, S3.5.p1, S4.p7). HU-t vs HU: PPAR signaling, peroxisome, SLC transport, ROS detox up; ECM, RNA splicing down.
